The new pins have a CONTROL. Ablation (3 fail / CONTROL passes on `origin/main`'s page) was not re-run here (no UI install in this container); read against the old code it holds: old wrapper carries `opacity-0` + `group-hover:` and buttons have no text → acceptance 1 fails; old buttons carry no `title` → acceptance 2 fails; old cells are `w-20` → column test fails; the quick row was enabled with no titles → CONTROL passes. |
| Acceptance 1 (visible without hover) | Met: no hiding class between button and row; pinned by `hidingClasses(button) == []` on both rows. |
| Acceptance 2 (disabled + reason on hover) | Met: both disabled, reason on button `title` + wrapper `title` (the wrapper takes the hover where `disabled:pointer-events-none` passes it through), accessible description asserted. |
| Card item 2 (words or tooltip + aria-label) | Met with visible words, as figure 9 shows; declared in `deviations` as the chosen branch. |
| UI strings | No new key. `approve` / `reject` / `colActions` exist in `approvalsInbox` in both `en.ts` (Approve / Reject / Actions) and `zh-Hans.ts` (通过 / 拒绝 / 操作). |

### Notes

1. Follow-up owed (not this PR's defect, not touched by it): `approvalsInbox.needsDecisionInputs` is missing from every locale file (`grep -rn needsDecisionInputs ui/packages/i18n/src` → 0 hits; the PR's tests log the en miss). The reason therefore renders the English `defaultValue` for zh-CN users, both before and after this PR; the PR only shows the same variable in one more `title`. The seat may file a small i18n card for the key in all ten locales; it is not an L1 bar here.
2. Real-browser reading at desktop width is NOT MEASURED (declared); the column change is pinned by classes only. Acceptable for an S card; the landing area may take a look in a browser if it boots the console anyway.
3. Declared deviation: the attribution line links the card thread instead of the seat thread named in standard-order. Harmless, no action.
4. Landing: base is behind current `main` but the file list does not overlap anything this seat holds open except #34586 (same file, lands after this one per triage 6936557306).
